_comment: Production overrides, merged on top of appsettings.json when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production (the IIS default). The connection string below uses Windows auth via the IIS app-pool identity (no password in the file). Set Jwt:Key to a long random secret before first run (the deploy-iis.ps1 script fills it automatically). Keep this file valid strict JSON (no // comments) so PowerShell can patch it.
